title: TransitEye Vehicle Density Schema
description: Schema for traffic flow and vehicle density metrics aggregated by edge perception models

id.description: Unique identifier for the density observation

segment_id.description: Road segment identifier for localized traffic aggregation

vehicle_count.description: Total count of vehicles observed in the frame or time window

class_breakdown.description: Breakdown of vehicle counts by class (e.g. car, bus, truck, motorcycle, auto_rickshaw)

metadata.description: Optional metadata (e.g. tracking algorithm, average speed, congestion level)
